baseline.kind: synthetic renderer with controlled IPC promises, not a native browser

scope: prepare a direct port, then check current selected connection/workspace and component lifetime before browser dispatch; release abandoned/failed forwards
compatibility: optional preparePort; old openPort retains its three inputs, return shape and immediate browser dispatch; absent preparePort uses old behavior
limitations: No new native port/browser verification in this stage.
A browser dispatch already submitted to the OS cannot be undone.
Legacy openPort fallback retains its old browser timing.
Terminal URL handling is not wired by this change.
